System_Information.Title: Illustrative humid DAC breakthrough - 400 ppm CO2 and 49 % RH on APDES-NFC
System_Information.Description: ILLUSTRATIVE, not a validated reproduction. Non-isothermal breakthrough of 400 ppm CO2 in humid N2 (y_H2O = 0.0115, 49 % RH at 20 degC, 1 bar) on the library adsorbent APDES-NFC: GAB water isotherm, humid Toth CO2 isotherm that reads the adsorbed water loading, LDF kinetics and heats of adsorption from the entry (Stampi-Bombelli et al. 2020, corrected 2022). Feed (50 cm3/s through an 8 cm column, 0.01 m/s), column diameter and wall heat transfer as in that paper; the bed length and the step time are chosen for the example. Water saturates the bed first and releases its heat of sorption; the CO2 front follows with the humid capacity.
